title: Best Eye Makeup (2026)
summary: BareMinerals’ creamy waterproof eyeliner leads the guide, with its mascara and eyeshadow rounding out the top picks for sensitive eyes.
method: Picks were chosen from BareMinerals US and UK site articles that list their top eye‑makeup products, favoring items mentioned in both sources.
assumptions: No pricing information was provided, so price fields are null.

products.name: BareMinerals Creamy Waterproof Eyeliner
why: The product is described as a creamy, long‑wearing eyeliner that is waterproof yet smooth‑gliding for non‑tugging application.
It is vegan, cruelty‑free and free from harsh additives, and it is both ophthalmologist‑tested and dermatologist‑tested, making it suitable for contact‑lens wearers.
products.desc: A creamy, waterproof eyeliner that glides smoothly without tugging. Formulated vegan, cruelty‑free and free of harsh additives; ophthalmologist‑ and dermatologist‑tested for sensitive eyes.
products.benefit: Picture a contact‑lens wearer needing a reliable liner for a long day at work. The eyeliner stays put, resists water, and won’t irritate delicate skin. It beats the mascara and eyeshadow here because it’s the only product offering both waterproof performance and a non‑tugging feel for sensitive eyes. The catch: precise application can be tricky for beginners.
cons: May require steady hand for precise lines
No mention of a built‑in brush
products.skip_if: You prefer a brush‑tip liner or need a very thick line

products.name: BareMinerals Lash‑Loving Mascara
why: The mascara is infused with a plant‑based serum to strengthen lashes while delivering buildable volume and length.
It is ophthalmologist‑tested, free of common irritants, and safe for contact‑lens wearers.
products.desc: A mascara with a plant‑based serum that adds volume and length. Ophthalmologist‑tested, free of common irritants and safe for contact‑lens wearers.
products.benefit: Picture someone with sensitive eyes who wants fuller lashes without irritation. The mascara builds volume and length while strengthening lashes. It wins over the eyeliner and eyeshadow for sheer volume, being the only product focused on lash enhancement. The catch: it may need multiple coats for maximum effect.

products.name: BareMinerals Talc‑Free Eyeshadow
why: The eyeshadows are made from 95% naturally derived ingredients and provide rich, blendable colour without irritation.
They are dermatologist‑tested, ophthalmologist‑tested and suitable for contact‑lens wearers.
products.desc: Talc‑free eyeshadows composed of 95% naturally derived ingredients. Dermatologist‑ and ophthalmologist‑tested, safe for contact‑lens wearers, and free of harsh additives.
products.benefit: Picture a makeup lover with sensitive skin wanting vibrant colour without redness. The eyeshadows deliver rich, blendable hues while staying irritation‑free. They stand out as the only non‑talc, naturally derived option in this guide. The catch: the colour range is limited to the shades listed by the brand.
products.skip_if: You need a wide palette of shades

verdict.line: Ideal for anyone with sensitive eyes or contact lenses who wants a long‑wearing, non‑tugging liner. It’s ophthalmologist‑ and dermatologist‑tested, vegan and cruelty‑free. The catch is that it may require a steady hand for precise application.
